comments.author: prezidento#23
comments.body_html:
To anyone who wants the dust cover to work for the VAL - here’s what I did:

I went to the following directory: “SPT_Data\Server\database\templates” and opened the file called “items”

There, I looked for the VAL’s ID, which is “57c44b372459772d2b39b8ce”.

Once I’ve found it, I’ve looked for the section called “mod_reciever”, and modified it as follows:

“{ “_name”: “mod_reciever”, “_id”: “57c44ce02459772d2b39b8d4”, “_parent”: “57c44b372459772d2b39b8ce”, “_props”: { “filters”: [ { “Shift”: 0, “Filter”: [ “57c44f4f2459772d2c627113”, “578395402459774a256959b5”, “5783954024597777256959b5” ] } ] },” “5783954024597777256959b5” is the VSSM dust cover’s ID, which was added to the “Filter” section.

I’ve also gone to “\user\mods\vssm\db\nerv_inv” and opened the “vssm_dustcover” file and done the following for good measure:

“slotsToAdd”: { “targetID”: [ “57838ad32459774a17445cd2”, “57c44b372459772d2b39b8ce” ], “slotName”: [ “mod_reciever” ] }, I’ve basically added the VAL’s ID to the “targetID” section.

This is just a quick and dirty fix, as it involves modifying the source files of SPT. If anyone has any suggestions how to make it into an compat patch or whatever, then please drop a comment.

comments.author: thedragonir
comments.body_html:
Hey, I found even easier way, without changing source files of SPT:
Go to: “\user\mods\vssm\db\nerv_inv\vssm_dustcover” and change

“slotsToAdd”: { “targetID”: [ “57838ad32459774a17445cd2” ], “slotName”: [ “mod_reciever” ] to:

“slotsToAdd”: { “targetID”: [ “57838ad32459774a17445cd2”, “57c44b372459772d2b39b8ce” ], “slotName”: [ “mod_reciever”, “mod_reciever” ]
